description: Defines the intra_slice_scheduler class responsible for scheduling UEs within a network slice, including methods for slot indication, post-processing, and UL/DL scheduling, along with internal structures and private helper functions.

classes.name: intra_slice_scheduler
classes.description: Main class for intra-slice UE scheduling, managing slot indications, scheduling policies, and resource allocation.

classes.name: slice_ue_group_scheduler
classes.description: Internal structure managing UE groups for a specific slice, including candidate generation and scheduling offsets.

methods.name: intra_slice_scheduler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the scheduler with configuration, resource allocators, and logger.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Resets or updates scheduler state at the beginning of a new slot.

methods.name: post_process_results
methods.description: Finalizes scheduling results after grants are allocated.

methods.name: dl_sched
methods.description: Schedules downlink grants for a slice.

methods.name: ul_sched
methods.description: Schedules uplink grants for a slice.

methods.name: can_allocate_pdsch
methods.description: Checks if a UE can be scheduled for DL in the current slot.

methods.name: can_allocate_pusch
methods.description: Checks if a UE can be scheduled for UL in the current slot.

methods.name: create_newtx_dl_candidate
methods.description: Creates a new DL transmission candidate for a UE.

methods.name: create_newtx_ul_candidate
methods.description: Creates a new UL transmission candidate for a UE.

methods.name: max_pdschs_to_alloc
methods.description: Calculates maximum number of PDSCHs to allocate.

methods.name: max_puschs_to_alloc
methods.description: Calculates maximum number of PUSCHs to allocate.
